_comment: Top-level shape of `sibil audit`. This file is written to disk on the client's machine (audit.json + audit.md + redaction_report.json). It is NEVER sent over the network by this CLI — there is no upload code path. Field names match cmd/audit.go.

system._comment: OS, kernel, uptime, CPU, load, RAM, disk — see collect/audit_system.go

listeners._comment: classified local/public/private via ss -tlnp; ports 22/80/443 excluded from risk_hints

observability._comment: one entry per detected service, score 0-1, gaps array
